name: FORECAST Festival 2026
description: FORECAST Festival is a unique four-day platform where emerging creative voices meet visionary mentors across disciplines. The program features performances, music, screenings, visual art, design, stand-up comedy, workshops, and conversations. Showcasing the culmination of year-long mentorships, it brings together artists, designers and innovators from around the world to present new works that explore the intersection of ideas, futures and creative practice. An essential gathering for witnessing where contemporary culture is headed.
